facts.text: The resort is at the base of Beaver Creek Mountain.
facts.excerpt: Nestled at the base of Beaver Creek Mountain, The Westin Riverfront Mountain Villas offers majestic views.

facts.text: The Riverfront Express Gondola, steps from the villas, connects Avon to Beaver Creek Mountain.
facts.excerpt: Just steps from your Vail Valley villa, the Riverfront Express Gondola provides seamless access from Avon to Beaver Creek Mountain

facts.text: The resort offers studio, one-bedroom and two-bedroom villas with furnished balconies or patios.
facts.excerpt: is a stylish studio, one- or two-bedroom villa offering relaxing moments on furnished balconies or patios.

facts.text: Villas have a kitchen or kitchenette, washers and dryers, and living spaces.
facts.excerpt: Villas come complete with luxurious like-home comforts including a kitchen or kitchenette, washers/dryers, living spaces, complimentary Wi-Fi

facts.text: Two-bedroom villas have two living areas, separate dining spaces, and a kitchen and kitchenette.
facts.excerpt: this spacious villa features two inviting living areas, separate dining spaces, and a well equipped kitchen and kitchenette.

facts.text: The two-bedroom villa sleeps up to eight.
facts.excerpt: The largest occupancy room at The Westin Riverfront Mountain Villas, Beaver Creek Mountain is the 2 Bedroom Villa with a maximum occupancy of 8.

facts.text: The resort has a heated 25-yard saltwater lap pool, open year-round, and three infinity hot tubs.
facts.excerpt: Unwind in the refreshing mountain air with a heated 25‑yard saltwater lap pool, open year‑round and ideal for both energizing swims and leisurely relaxation. Then ease into one of three infinity hot tubs

facts.text: Spa Anjali's treatments draw on Alpine European techniques, Himalayan Ayurvedic practices and Native American healing traditions of the Rocky Mountains.
facts.excerpt: Experience restorative Alpine European techniques, Himalayan Ayurvedic practices, and Native American healing traditions rooted in the Rocky Mountains

facts.text: Spa Anjali has a full-service salon.
facts.excerpt: Featuring 14 treatment rooms and a full-service salon

facts.text: The Athletic Club at Westin has Technogym and Peloton equipment and offers classes including yoga and Pilates.
facts.excerpt: a world‑class fitness center featuring Technogym and Peloton equipment, challenging strength machines, and state‑of‑the‑art training technology. Enjoy a variety of fitness classes, including yoga, Pilates, and more.

facts.text: Colletta serves modern Italian cuisine with house-made pastas and wood-fired pizzas.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy lively, modern Italian cuisine at Colletta, featuring house-made pastas, wood-fired pizzas, and delightful cocktails.

facts.text: The Lobby Bar & Lounge looks out over Beaver Creek and the Eagle River.
facts.excerpt: Experience breathtaking vistas of Beaver Creek and the Eagle River.

facts.text: Year-round activities include skiing, hiking, biking, fishing and whitewater rafting.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy year-round resort activities like skiing, hiking, biking, fishing, and thrilling whitewater rafting.

facts.text: In summer guests can fly-fish, kayak and raft on the Eagle River.
facts.excerpt: Get up to some summertime fun in Beaver Creek with fly-fishing, kayaking and rafting on Eagle River
No, pets are not allowed at The Westin Riverfront Mountain Villas, Beaver Creek Mountain.

facts.text: Eagle County Airport is the closest airport, about 35 miles away.
facts.excerpt: The closest airport near The Westin Riverfront Mountain Villas, Beaver Creek Mountain is Eagle County Airport (EGE). EGE is located approximately 35.0 Miles from the hotel.

facts.text: The property is a vacation ownership resort.
